en: Art Nouveau–style illustration featuring a circular medallion with the head of a young woman with long red hair crowned with white flowers. A large white lily with green leaves rises along the left side. The background is a textured mix of dark green and brown tones. There is an empty light-colored label area at the bottom for writing, with a faint round postal-style mark. Stylized letters in what appears to be Greek script are printed near the top right and left.
